description: This JavaScript module provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, mainly USD, with customizable options such as decimal precision, inclusion of credits, and formatting style. It ensures consistent display of monetary values across the application, with special handling for small numbers, large numbers, and optional credits based on USD amounts.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string, with options for currency code, decimal precision, and optional credits suffix. Handles small and large numbers with dynamic precision rules and uses Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware formatting.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with an appended credits indicator, leveraging formatCurrencyAmount with includeCredits set to true.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separators and up to six decimal places for detailed precision.
